name: media-library-manager
description: Cross-platform desktop app to manage a media library: local device files, local network shares, and configurable site search with seamless handoff to your default torrent app.

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node --openssl-legacy-provider --test --test-force-exit --test-reporter=spec test/torrentManager.test.mjs test/copyManager.test.mjs test/remoteQueue.test.mjs test/ntlmv2.test.mjs test/cast.test.mjs test/tv.test.mjs
